plain_statement: It is false that: The edge function of the Petersen graph minus a vertex (9 inputs, 12 edges). Give a circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates with at most 14 gates the nine inputs and a tenth wire. Then either at some input with x_0 or x_4 off it differs from the function when the tenth wire is false, or at some input with x_0 and x_4 on it is false when the tenth wire is true.
